name: Credit Reports
tagline: Pulls your three credit reports, marks errors and fraud, and fights them for you.
description: It pulls all three bureau files - Experian, Equifax and TransUnion - then reads them line by line for anything inaccurate or that you never opened. Disputes go out the fast way where a bureau accepts online filings, and as mail-in letters ready to sign where it does not. Born of a real identity-theft cleanup.
author: josephstayhappy
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
